prompt: Create a polished editorial lifestyle portrait of a successful young Black male executive in a bright modern office, posed confidently at a white marble desk. He is standing slightly angled toward the camera with one hand resting on an open silver laptop and the other hand in his trouser pocket, wearing a tailored deep burgundy double-breasted suit, crisp white dress shirt, slim black tie, black dress buttons, luxury wristwatch, and black rectangular sunglasses. His expression is serious and composed, with short neatly trimmed black hair and smooth grooming, conveying ambition, discipline, and self-respect. The office background includes a framed certificate on the left wall reading “CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION” with smaller award text, a gold seal, and a signature; a geometric abstract wall artwork on the right; a tall snake plant in a white planter; a small globe; and exactly four stacked black books labeled “LEADERSHIP,” “STRATEGY,” “INNOVATION,” and “SUCCESS.” On the desk include exactly seven visible objects: an open silver laptop, a black smartphone, a teal clipboard holding a document titled “STRATEGIC GROWTH,” a black-and-gold pen, a cut-crystal water glass, a dark glass decanter labeled “DISCIPLINE CREATES FREEDOM,” and a gray USB hub. Add two black books in the foreground with gold text, the top one reading “PEOPLE IDEAS RESULTS.” Use warm natural sunlight with diagonal window-blind shadows across the wall and subject, crisp high-end fashion photography lighting, shallow but readable background detail, realistic textures, premium corporate decor, vertical portrait composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, ultra-realistic, magazine cover quality. Avoid extra people, distorted hands, misspelled main labels, clutter, or cartoon styling.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的编辑风格生活肖像，主角是一位成功的年轻黑人男性高管，身处明亮的现代办公室，自信地站在白色大理石办公桌前。他身体微微侧向镜头，一只手放在打开的银色笔记本电脑上，另一只手插在西裤口袋里，身穿剪裁合身的 深酒红色 双排扣西装、挺括的白色衬衫、黑色细领带，搭配黑色西装扣、奢华腕表和黑色长方形太阳镜。他表情严肃沉稳，留着修剪整齐的短发，仪容整洁，传达出雄心、自律和自尊。办公室背景包括：左侧墙上挂着一张写有“CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION”的证书，配有小型获奖文字、金色印章和签名；右侧挂着抽象几何墙面艺术品；一个白色花盆中的高大虎皮兰；一个小地球仪；以及正好四本叠放的黑色书籍，书脊分别标有“LEADERSHIP”、“STRATEGY”、“INNOVATION”和“SUCCESS”。桌面上包含正好七件可见物品：一台打开的银色笔记本电脑、一部黑色智能手机、一个夹着标题为“STRATEGIC GROWTH”文件的青色写字板、一支黑金配色的钢笔、一个切割水晶水杯、一个标有“DISCIPLINE CREATES FREEDOM”的深色玻璃醒酒器，以及一个灰色 USB 集线器。在前景处增加两本带有金色文字的黑色书籍，最上面的一本写着“PEOPLE IDEAS RESULTS”。使用温暖的自然阳光，让百叶窗的斜影投射在墙壁和主体上，采用清晰的高端时尚摄影布光，背景细节浅景深但清晰可见，纹理真实，体现高端企业装饰风格，采用竖构图，2:3 比例，超写实，杂志封面级画质。避免出现多余人物、手部变形、主要标签拼写错误、杂乱或卡通风格。
